text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B in stages felt rewarding, while selling Stocks D and E at large losses was painful; I should use consistent, pre-set reasons for selling rather than let either feeling dictate timing.","My account value moved sharply even when I made no trades, so I should judge the portfolio by its overall risk and diversification—not by a few realized gains or short-term changes.","Since I trade rarely, I should review my holdings periodically and make deliberate adjustments only when my plan or the investment case warrants them."]}
